purpose: Dated research observations, not dependency pins or a tested compatibility matrix.

angular_docs_reference_row.limitation: Verify the exact selected release. Do not infer all later minor requirements from this row.

local_helper_environment.note: Record actual helper environment in VALIDATION.md; not the selected Node24 build/release toolchain.

preflight_required: Resolve full immutable baseline/current commits from official Git remote.
Verify published npm versions, package integrity and peer manifests; GitHub source manifests may contain placeholders.
Pin exact framework/CLI/compiler, Material/CDK, ng-packagr, TypeScript, RxJS, Sass, package manager and browser versions.
Record a tested minimum/maximum peer matrix rather than promising arbitrary current or prerelease compatibility.
Record research head and release baseline separately. Verify branch-specific API availability against installed/packed aged peer versions and advertised minimums, not research-head source.
typescript7_note: TypeScript 7.0 has no old programmatic compiler API; isolate migration AST access and allow @typescript/typescript6 where necessary.
publication: GitHub Actions standard public runners; npm trusted publishing/OIDC; staged publishing after package bootstrap.

angular_framework_observation.note: Do not assume Angular framework and Angular Components share the same latest minor on a given day. Resolve and test an actually compatible set at implementation/release time.

toolchain_status: Exact Node24/pnpm12/release-npm pins selected from official release evidence; installation, registry timestamp/integrity capture, and Angular compatibility builds remain implementation preflight.

release_baseline_policy.selection: Per supported branch, explicitly resolve and verify an aged compatible published package set; allow only a reviewed exact-version urgent exception. Research refs and source examples do not select runtime peers.
release_baseline_policy.api_availability: For every delegated TypeScript/Sass API, prove it exists in the exact packed release baseline and the advertised minimum peer version. An API seen only at the research head is not usable by assumption.
release_baseline_policy.fresh_fix_handling: Record relevance immediately. If a necessary fix is absent from the release baseline, safely adapt it to owned code or use a justified exact-version exception for a fixed peer and test it. Otherwise block affected releases; never silently install an unaged peer or defer an applicable severe vulnerability just to satisfy age.
release_baseline_policy.canary_isolation: No release lockfile mutations, publishing credentials or release artifacts from research/canary dependency environments.
